title: A table between two paragraphs
concept:
A table is the content of its own paragraph: the
before it ends the text paragraph above, and the
right after ends the table's paragraph, so the text after it starts a new one.

annotations.note:
An ordinary first paragraph, ended by its
.

The Table is the second paragraph's only content. It has no position of its own: it draws where that paragraph lands in the frame. Each paragraph has its own range here; one range over all three paragraphs would be just as valid, since a range is a style run.
One Row per row and one Column per column. HeaderRowCount 1 plus BodyRowCount 2 is three rows.
Each Cell names its grid position (column:row) and holds its own paragraphs; here every edge carries a 0.5 pt black stroke.

The table's paragraph ends with a
right after , in the same CharacterStyleRange. Without it the text that follows would join the table's paragraph.
The third paragraph: text after the table starts below it.
